# Delta Dental of New Mexico

> Delta Dental of New Mexico provides comprehensive dental insurance plans, member portals, and 24/7 teledentistry services for individuals, families, employers, and public sector employees across New Mexico.

Delta Dental of New Mexico serves as a regional dental insurance provider offering PPO and Premier network plans, virtual dental care, and dedicated member services for various employer groups including APS, NMPSIA, and the New Mexico Health Care Authority. The site provides comprehensive resources for plan selection, benefit management, and claims processing.

## Individual & Family Plans

- [Individual and Family Services](https://www.deltadentalnm.com/individuals-family): Individual and family dental insurance plans and coverage options from Delta Dental.
- [Individual and Family Dental Plans](https://www.deltadentalnm.com/individuals-family/see-individual-plans): Affordable individual and family dental plan options including MySmileCoverage.
- [Our Networks | Individuals & Families](https://www.deltadentalnm.com/individuals-family/our-networks): Delta Dental PPO and Premier network options for individuals and families.
- [Understanding Your Benefits | Individuals & Families](https://www.deltadentalnm.com/individuals-family/understanding-my-benefits): Guide to understanding dental benefits, coverage, and cost-saving strategies.
- [TeleDentistry: 24/7 Emergency Dental Care for You & Your Family](https://www.deltadentalnm.com/individuals-family/teledentistry): 24/7 virtual dental care and emergency services for members and families.
- [Member Portal | Individual's & Family](https://www.deltadentalnm.com/individuals-family/member-portal): Online portal for managing dental benefits, claims, and ID cards.

## Member Services & Resources

- [Member Services](https://www.deltadentalnm.com/member): Central hub for member resources, portal access, and dental benefit information.
- [Member Portal](https://www.deltadentalnm.com/member/member-portal): Secure online access to eligibility, claims, ID cards, and dentist search.
- [Understanding Your Benefits | Member](https://www.deltadentalnm.com/member/understanding-my-benefits): Comprehensive guide to maximizing dental benefits and coverage options.
- [Our Networks | Members](https://www.deltadentalnm.com/member/our-networks): Delta Dental PPO and Premier network comparison for member savings.
- [TeleDentistry for Members | Access to 24/7 Virtual Dental Care](https://www.deltadentalnm.com/member/teledentistry): 24/7 virtual dental care and emergency services for Delta Dental members.
- [Out-of-Country Claims](https://www.deltadentalnm.com/member/out-of-country-claims): International dental coverage and out-of-country claims submission process.

## Employer & Group Plans

- [APS Member Services](https://www.deltadentalnm.com/member/aps-members): Dedicated member services and benefits information for APS employees.
- [New Mexico Health Care Authority Member Services](https://www.deltadentalnm.com/member/nm-health-care-authority-members): Member services and enrollment info for NMHCA employees and beneficiaries.
- [NMPSIA Member Services](https://www.deltadentalnm.com/member/nmpsia-members): Member services and benefits for NMPSIA public school employees.

- [Delta Dental of New Mexico FAQs](https://www.deltadentalnm.com/tools/faqs): Frequently asked questions about Delta Dental plans and member services.
